security.notes: No production code, service, or trust boundary changed by this build — it is skill/doc authoring plus one linter rule. The one new enforcement surface (WC-1's $ARGUMENTS body guard) is itself a defense-in-depth improvement (prevents a Claude-Code-only token from silently reaching 10 other hosts via convert.sh) and was verified to actually fire (ERROR + exit 1) rather than assumed. PX-1/PX-3 explicitly carry forward a security-relevant caveat (imaged bulk is gist-only, never the sole copy of secrets/hashes) and a fail-closed default (unlisted/new models are NOT allowed behind the image proxy by default) rather than a fail-open one. No secrets, credentials, or exposed endpoints introduced; no scan tooling exists in this repo to run beyond the lint/bats gates already executed.
